settings.title: Settings
settings.imageProcessingDesc: Configure image quality and output sizes.
settings.qualityHintWebp: 1-100. WebP 90 is roughly visually equivalent to JPEG 90. Higher = better quality, larger files.
settings.qualityHintAvif: 1-100. AVIF 85 is roughly visually equivalent to JPEG 95 at a smaller file size. Higher = better quality, larger files.
settings.qualityHintJpeg: 1-100. JPEG 90 is a typical web target; 95+ for archive-grade. Higher = better quality, larger files.
settings.imageSizesHint: Comma-separated pixel widths (e.g. 640,1536,2048,4096,5120,7680). Auto-sorted and deduped, max 8, locked once photos exist.
settings.privacyDesc: Choose what metadata to keep on upload.
settings.stripGps: Do Not Store GPS Coordinates on Upload
settings.stripGpsHint: New uploads won't store GPS in gallery metadata and will remove GPS from retained originals when possible. Existing images are unchanged.
settings.loadFailed: Could not load settings. Please try again before saving changes.
settings.imageSizesLockedHint: Output sizes are locked because photos already exist. Empty the gallery to change them.
settings.uploadContractLocked: Image size and GPS settings are locked for an existing gallery, so old and new uploads stay consistent.
settings.slideshowIntervalHint: 2–30 seconds. How long each photo is shown in slideshow mode.
settings.autoAltTextDesc: Create EXIF-derived alt-text placeholders after processing. Local Florence-2 inference is not implemented yet.
settings.autoAltTextEnabledHint: When enabled, creates a basic EXIF-derived hint after each image is processed. Real model-generated descriptions are a future feature.
settings.semanticSearchDesc: Enable CLIP-based semantic image search. Stub mode uses deterministic placeholder embeddings that are not meaningful and should only be used to test wiring. Production mode uses the real CLIP encoder and is operator-gated: it activates only when the server sets SEMANTIC_SEARCH_ALLOW_PRODUCTION (otherwise a stored 'production' value behaves as disabled). Run the backfill script after enabling.
settings.semanticSearchEnabledHint: When enabled, shows a semantic search toggle in the search box. Requires the embedding backfill to complete first. (Stub embeddings are deterministic but not semantically meaningful.)
settings.semanticSearchProductionWarning: A "production" value is set, but production semantic search is operator-only and is treated as Disabled here unless the server is explicitly opted in. Re-select Disabled or Stub to apply a UI-supported mode.
settings.forceSrgbDerivatives: Force sRGB on WebP/JPEG only (AVIF stays wide-gamut)
settings.forceSrgbDerivativesHint: When ON, only the WebP and JPEG variants are converted to sRGB regardless of source color space. AVIF variants always carry their original gamut. Use this only if downstream consumers (legacy embedders, specific clients) require sRGB JPEGs.
settings.allowHdrIngestHint: When ON, PQ and HLG source images can be uploaded; public WebP/JPEG/AVIF derivatives are still delivered as SDR. When OFF (default), HDR uploads are rejected.
settings.forceShowColorChipsHint: When ON, the P3 gamut badge and HDR badge are always visible in the photo viewer, even on sRGB displays. Useful for photographers who want to verify color metadata regardless of the visitor's display.
settings.firefoxDisplayGapNoteDetail: Firefox may not reliably report P3/HDR display capability through browser APIs on every platform, so gamut/HDR badges and the wide-gamut educational hint can be hidden even on capable displays. Enabling "Force Show Color Chips" above surfaces badges to Firefox visitors.
settings.wideGamutJpegChromaHint: Chroma subsampling for wide-gamut JPEG derivatives. 4:4:4 preserves full color detail but produces larger files. 4:2:0 is smaller but may show color bleeding in fine gradients.
settings.avifEffortHint: 0-9 range matches Sharp's actual capability. Lower = faster, larger files. Higher = slower, smaller files. Sharp's native default is 4; we default to 6 (~10% smaller files at ~30% extra CPU vs. 4). 9 is the slowest/smallest.
settings.sdrJpegChromaHint: Chroma subsampling for sRGB / non-wide-gamut JPEG derivatives. Default 4:2:0 (smaller files; mild red-edge smear on saturated colors). Choose 4:4:4 for crisp saturated colors at the cost of file size.
settings.wideGamutMaxSourcePixelsHint: Pixel-count cap above which wide-gamut sources are downscaled before the rgb16 pipeline. Default 50,000,000 (50 MP). Higher values use more memory; only raise on hosts with several GB of RAM.
settings.backfillRequiredHint: This gallery already has uploaded images. Changing color/HDR encoder settings requires a re-encode before existing images get new bytes. The in-app button processes photos below the current pipeline version; settings-only changes need the sidecar backfill with --force-reencode.
settings.backfillTriggerHint: Runs the color-pipeline backfill on this live host. Re-encodes every photo whose pipeline version is below the current encoder. Safe after a pipeline version bump; settings-only changes need the sidecar backfill with --force-reencode. A second click while a run is in flight is a no-op.
settings.backfillQueued: Re-encoding queued — {count} photo(s) will be processed in the background.
settings.backfillNothingToDo: All photos are already at the current pipeline version. Nothing to re-encode.
settings.backfillAlreadyRunning: A re-encode run is already in progress.
settings.backfillUnavailable: Re-encode is unavailable while a database restore is active.
settings.backfillFailed: Failed to queue re-encode. Check server logs.
settings.backfillLastRunWithFailures: Completed with failures — {processed} re-encoded, {errors} fatal error(s), {encodeFailures} encode failure(s), {detectionFailures} detection failure(s). Affected photos kept their previous version and will be retried on the next run.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: How GalleryKit handles visitor analytics and photo metadata.
privacy.intro: GalleryKit is a self-hosted photo gallery. This site publishes processed photo derivatives and the public metadata needed to browse them.
privacy.analyticsEnabled: This site loads Google Analytics to measure visits and interactions. Google may receive request and device information according to its own policies.
privacy.analyticsDisabled: Google Analytics is not configured on this site.
privacy.metadataBody: Standard gallery and photo pages exclude GPS coordinates. The public map can show coordinates only for topics an admin explicitly marks as map-visible. Upload settings can strip location data from original files before storage when that privacy option is enabled.

lrToken.title: Upload API Tokens
lrToken.description: Generate bearer tokens for server-side upload integrations. Anyone with a token can use its scopes until it expires or is revoked, so store it like a password. GalleryKit exposes the API endpoint; it does not bundle or distribute a Lightroom Classic plugin.

lrToken.createDesc: Give this bearer token a memorable label. Upload access is granted automatically. Anyone who sees the plaintext token can upload until it expires or is revoked.
lrToken.plaintextDesc: Copy this bearer token now and store it like a password. It will not be shown again after you close this dialog.
lrToken.plaintextAcknowledge: I copied this token or stored it somewhere safe. I understand it cannot be shown again.

lrToken.revokeDesc: Revoking this token will immediately block upload clients using it.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.approximateDisclaimer: View counts are approximate. The server buffers events in memory and flushes them asynchronously, so a recent restart or extended DB outage may undercount delivered views. Shared-album counts also only increment on the initial page load — intra-share navigation is not counted.
